summary: Frontend-only manual + Playwright testing of GullyScore Expo web preview at 390x844 mobile viewport. End-to-end flow verified: Dashboard (dark default + demo match + theme toggle), New Match setup (players/overs chips, team inputs, toss), openers modal, Live scoring (runs 0/1/2/3/4/6, wide/no ball/bye/leg bye, wicket, undo, over completion -> newbowl modal), innings transition with target box and chase-banner, end-of-match modal -> Result page (result-text, top-scorer, best-bowler, view-scorecard-button) -> Full Scorecard (both innings batting + bowling), and History screen. No React Native red-screen errors. Console warnings: deprecated shadow* and pointerEvents style props (non-blocking RN-web warnings).

issues: Header score block + chase banner is tall on small phones; functional but could be more compact

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Affects dashboard CTA shadow. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:277-281 (ctaButton shadow*).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely emitted by Modal/Touchable internals from RNW; if found in custom code, move pointerEvents into style.

action_items: Migrate shadow* style props on TouchableOpacity in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (ctaButton style) to boxShadow for RN-Web (and any other shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset usages). Keep elevation for Android.
Audit any custom pointerEvents prop usage; move into style if found.
Consider compacting the Live header on small viewports (score row + chase banner can crowd the pad on 390x844 with safe-area).
critical_code_review_comments: live.tsx innings memo has a redundant branch: it returns innings2 in both `closed` and `!closed` cases before falling to innings1 - the second branch is dead code (line 80-86). Harmless but should be simplified.
Snapshot stack in live.tsx grows unbounded per ball; consider capping to last N (e.g., 60) to prevent memory bloat in long matches.
seed_data_creation: Used app's built-in seedDemoIfNeeded (demo_match_1). For E2E I cleared localStorage and ran a fresh 2-over, 7-a-side match.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully offline (AsyncStorage / localStorage in web). Clear localStorage before E2E. Mobile viewport 390x844. Striker/nonstriker/bowler chips live inside horizontally-scrollable rows inside a bottom sheet modal; Playwright force=true alone fails with 'outside viewport' - use JS click via element.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) + .click() instead.
